evidence: Carries the P2P label and adds network protocol messages, NODE_UTXO_SET service bit, and chunk transfer handlers in src/net_processing.cpp.
rationale: Implements a draft BIP protocol for sharing UTXO set snapshots across peers to remove out-of-band distribution friction. Facilitates in-band snapshot discovery and downloading over P2P, addressing centralized distribution points for fast node onboarding.
